title: Coverage Level Rate Card — Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan
content:
The Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan is sold at six coverage levels. Each level fixes three figures: the coverage limit (the most the plan pays for one loss, before the deductible), the monthly protection fee, and the deductible (the amount the tenant bears on each covered loss, subtracted once per claim).

## Rate card

| Coverage level | Coverage limit per loss (USD) | Monthly protection fee (USD) | Deductible per covered loss (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $2,000 Plan | 2000.00 | 12.00 | 100.00 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $3,000 Plan | 3000.00 | 15.00 | 100.00 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $5,000 Plan | 5000.00 | 22.00 | 100.00 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $7,500 Plan | 7500.00 | 29.00 | 250.00 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $10,000 Plan | 10000.00 | 36.00 | 250.00 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $15,000 Plan | 15000.00 | 49.00 | 250.00 |

## Billing basis

At every level the monthly protection fee is billed with the rent on the covered rental's billing day. The fee shown is the full monthly amount for the level.

## Reading the card

- **Coverage limit.** The limit is a ceiling on what the plan pays for one loss, measured before the deductible is taken off.
- **Deductible.** The three lower levels ($2,000, $3,000 and $5,000) carry a deductible of 100.00; the three upper levels ($7,500, $10,000 and $15,000) carry 250.00.
- **Fee steps.** Moving one level up the card raises the monthly fee by 3.00 (from $2,000 to $3,000), 7.00 ($3,000 to $5,000), 7.00 ($5,000 to $7,500), 7.00 ($7,500 to $10,000) and 13.00 ($10,000 to $15,000).

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A tenant holding a hypothetical $7,500 Plan on one unit is billed 29.00 with each month's rent; a covered loss on that plan is paid up to a limit of 7500.00 before a deductible of 250.00 comes off. The same tenant holding the $2,000 Plan on a second unit is billed 12.00 for that unit, with a limit of 2000.00 and a deductible of 100.00 — each plan carries its own figures.
